text: There is a much debated chapter from Egils Saga that discusses the location of Egils buried in treasure in the Mosfell Valley. This story relates a tale about a buried treasure that Egil Skallagrimsson received from King Aðalstein of England, made up of two chests filled with silver. This treasure is known in legend and in Icelandic popular culture as Silfur Egils (Egils Silver). Egil wanted to ride to the Althing, the national assembly, and toss his treasure from the Law Rock when the crowd was at its biggest in order to see the people break out into a brawl over his silver. Hearing his intentions, Egil's son-in-law denied him permission to ride to the Althing and as a consequence Egil decided to hide his treasure from all men.
